shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/; git status --short | head -50

cat AGENTS.md; echo ---; cat index.html; echo ---; find src -type f | xargs ls -la; for f in src/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "== $f"; cat "$f"; }; done; echo ---; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; echo ---; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts

S=.agents/skills/gravity-ui; cat $S/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ======; cat $S/references/theming.md | head -300; echo ======; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -120; echo ======; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit dist-tags version 2>&1 | head -20

S=.agents/skills/gravity-ui; wc -l $S/references/theming.md; grep -n "^#" $S/references/theming.md; echo ===; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit dist-tags 2>&1 | head; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version 2>&1 | tail -3
npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 peerDependencies engines dependencies 2>/dev/null; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 dist.tarball 2>/dev/null

npm view @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 peerDependenciesMeta 2>/dev/null; npm install @gravity-ui/uikit@8.0.0 --save-exact 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn Unknown env" | tail -15; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version"; git diff --stat; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && wc -l INDEX.md; cat INDEX.md | head -150; echo ====; ls guides components hooks | head -150
wc -l guides/migration-to-v8.md guides/theming.md; cat guides/migration-to-v8.md | head -250

sed -n 1,200p components/Switch.md; echo ====; grep -rn "export type Theme\b\|export type RealTheme\|export type Theme " ../*.d.ts ../**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -rn "export type Theme =\|export type RealTheme" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head -5

grep -n "Provider\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/Provider.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ===; cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs && grep -n "gap\|direction\|<Flex" guides/layout.md | head -40; echo ===; grep -n "Flex" guides/migration-layout-v8.md | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && grep -rln "padding" components/layout/Box/*.d.ts components/layout/Flex/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "padding?" components/layout/Box/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn "color?" components/Text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn "variant?" components/Text/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls components/Text 2>/dev/null

cat components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -40; grep -rln "paddingInline\|padding" components/layout --include=*.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "padding" components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -30; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npx vite build --outDir /tmp/gravity-build --emptyOutDir 2>&1 | tail -15
